Maya R.: quick sync — proposing we standardize a 'soft-bind' signal in rollout metadata that is purely advisory to the router/hosts (i.e. not a hard lock). thinking: explicit "bind_type" + optional "lease" token where client can opt-in to respect it.
Samir K.: +1 to having explicit bind_type. question: how do we express coupling between lease lifetime and rollout TTL? e.g. if rollout TTL < lease TTL, do we truncate lease? also need to clarify fallback ordering.
Jin L.: important: clients should never assume advisory binds mean model will stay pinned. treat as hint. fallback ordering should be: pinned variant -> tenant default -> global default -> fallback model. document that sequence in metadata contract.
Priya S.: telemetry ask: expose bind_source and bind_signal_strength in traces. bind_signal_strength could be "advisory" | "preferred" | "hard" so we can alert on drifting usages. propose adding these fields to rollout manifest and to the pin reconciliation logs.
Maya R.: sketch of proposed manifest snippet below (for discussion):
```json
{
  "model_id": "open-gpt-xl",
  "variant": "v2",
  "rollout": {
    "bind_type": "soft",            // soft | hard
    "bind_strength": "advisory",   // advisory | preferred | hard
    "lease": {
      "token": "lease_abc123",
      "expires_at": "2026-05-01T12:00:00Z"
    },
    "fallback_order": ["variant","tenant_default","global_default"]
  }
}
```
Samir K.: nit: prefer "expires_at" to be ms-since-epoch in server records to avoid tz issues; UI can render ISO. also: what should controller do on lease mismatch? reject update vs accept and emit warning?
Jin L.: controller behavior: accept but annotate rollouts with "lease_mismatch=true" and push reconciliation job. immediate reject will break canaries.
Priya S.: ops playbook note: when bind_strength==hard, controller should attempt eviction protection and notify on unbind events. add alert rule for hard binds beyond X hours.
deploy-bot: CANARY: model-deploy/open-gpt-xl:v2 canary started by Maya R. — route weight 5% — id canary-3420001111
Maya R.: action items: 1) Samir to convert expires_at to epoch ms and write server validation rules. 2) Jin to draft client shim semantics (advisory vs preferred). 3) Priya to add telemetry fields and draft alert thresholds. 4) Ops to review hard-bind eviction protections. Aim for RFC follow-up next week. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
Samir K.: ack, will PR validation rules by EOD Thurs.
Jin L.: will add client shim notes to SDK backlog ticket.
Priya S.: will stub telemetry panel and share link in channel.
Maya R.: thanks — keeping this short. ping me if anything blocks.
